result.title: Recurrent Self-Improvement: Dynamic Cross-Loop On-Policy Distillation for Looped Language Models
result.summary: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) offer a parameter efficient approach to scaling reasoning by reusing shared parameters across recurrent computation steps. Despite their promise, effective post-training of LoopLMs remains challenging. Existing approaches either provide reward based supervision that is sparse or costly to extend across loops, or rely on external teachers or privileged information, leading to limited teacher availability or teacher-student context mismatch. To address these limitations, we introduce LoopOPD, a cross-loop on-policy distillation framework that uses additional recurrent computation within a LoopLM as its own source of supervision. LoopOPD uses a frozen terminal loop policy as a compute privileged teacher for an intermediate loop student on student generated rollouts, providing dense supervision without an external teacher or privileged information. We further propose Dynamic LoopOPD (D-LoopOPD), which continually refreshes the terminal loop teacher as the shared model parameters are updated, enabling recurrent self-improvement. We characterize how distillation updates propagate across loop depths and derive sufficient conditions under which a single update yields simultaneous local improvement at both loop depths. Experiments on Ouro-Thinking models show that LoopOPD improves mathematical reasoning, while D-LoopOPD yields further gains through dynamic teacher updates. Despite being trained only on mathematical data, the resulting models also improve on general reasoning and code generation benchmarks, demonstrating that recurrent computation can serve as an effective source of supervision for LoopLMs. Our code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 Looped LM 后训练中奖励稀疏、外部教师缺失或师生上下文不匹配的问题，提出跨循环 on-policy 蒸馏 LoopOPD：以冻结的末端循环策略作为「算力特权」教师，监督中间循环的学生模型，并用动态刷新教师的 D-LoopOPD 实现循环式自我改进，另给出单次更新在两层循环上同时局部改进的充分条件，在数学推理等基准上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨循环深度的蒸馏监督与更新传播分析，可能为 LVR 中循环步数间的贡献分配、轨迹级监督和自监督信号来源提供可核查线索，但仅面向纯文本模型、不含视觉状态。
